text.tspan: The figure shows an ideal gas in a cylindrical container with a piston that can move with negligible friction. The
container is placed in hot water that is kept at a constant temperature. As the gas reaches thermal equilibrium with
the water, the root-mean-square speed of the gas atoms doubles while the gas pressure remains constant. Which of
, the ratio of the final volume
Correct. The temperature is proportional to the square of
speed by a factor of two will increase temperature by a factor of four
which will result in the volume increasing by a factor of
